name: Order Flow Absorption Reversal

anti_hunt: Trailing Stop → entfernt sich vom Hunt

hypothesis: When large volume trades at a price level with no further price movement, passive institutional orders absorb aggressive market orders. Once absorption completes, price reverses.
edge_rationale: Absorption is the mechanism behind support/resistance. Aggressor exhausts, price reverses.
best_when: Range-bound or pullback markets. US session.
worst_when: Trending markets with momentum. Forex spot.
entry_conditions: Price drops to support + high volume stalls = buy absorption -> long
Price rises to resistance + high volume stalls = sell absorption -> short
exit_tp_logic: Opposite side of range. Trail using delta.
notes: REQUIRES real order book data. Best on ES/NQ futures. NOT for forex spot.
